text:
MIN 740 (M+F) List of MCA Recognised private nautical chart producers under MGN 293 (M+F)
This Marine Information Note (MIN) lists MCA recognised private chart producers that meet MGN 293 (M+F) requirements for alternative paper chart carriage on eligible vessels under 24m in length
Documents
Details
Notice to all Private Nautical Chart Producers, Code Vessel and Fishing Vessel Owners, Masters, Skippers and Officers
This notice should be read in conjunction with MGN 293(M+F).
This MIN expires 15th April 2028.
